content: We had a theory about China.
translation: 我们有一个关于中国的设想。

content: We had read things. Watch the news, talk to people who had been there.
translation: 我们读过一些东西。 看那里的新闻，和去过那里的人聊过。

content: We thought we had a reasonable picture of what to expect.
translation: 我们认为我们对预期情况有合理的了解。

content: We were wrong.
translation: 我们错了。

content: Not a little wrong, almost entirely wrong.
translation: 不是错了一点，几乎完全错了。

content: This is the 1st video in a series about 22 days inside China.
translation: 这是中国境内约22天的系列视频中的第1个。

content: We traveled privately, just the 2 of us, with a different local guide in each city.
translation: 这是我们的私人旅行，只有我们2个人，每个城市都有不同的当地导游。

content: No tour buses, no group schedules,
translation: 没有旅游巴士，没有团体时间表，

content: just us.
translation: 只有我们。

content: Moving through one of the most extraordinary countries on Earth,
translation: 穿越地球上最非凡的国家之一，

content: trying our best to understand it.
translation: 尽力去理解它。

content: We are going to show you the landscapes and the food.
translation: 我们将向您展示风景和食物。

content: And the things you come to China to see.
translation: 还有你来中国会看的东西。

content: But we are also going to try to explain something harder. What this country actually is, how it thinks,
translation: 但我们也会尝试解释一些更难的事情。 这个国家到底是怎么样的，它是怎么想的，

content: what it has been through. Why it ended up here.
translation: 它经历了什么。 为什么它最终会在这里。

content: Because if you only watch the pretty pictures, you will miss the whole story.
translation: 因为如果你只看漂亮的图片，你会错过整个故事。

content: My name is Tressa.
translation: 我叫Tressa。

content: That guy you keep seeing on screen, exploring everything,
translation: 你在屏幕上一直看到的那个家伙，探索着一切，

content: sitting in every car.
translation: 坐在每辆车里。

content: That's my husband, Sarco.
translation: 那是我丈夫，Sarco。

content: Together we run this channel.
translation: 我们一起运营这个频道。

content: And together we spent 22 days, traveling China privately.
translation: 我们一起花了22天时间，在中国私下旅行。

content: We came back with more questions than answers, which honestly is the best possible outcome from any trip.
translation: 我们回来时的问题多于答案，老实说，这是任何旅行的最佳结果。片段来自于一对来中国旅行的博主。
